name: arxsource-mcp
description: Search arXiv, read bounded full text and original LaTeX, follow citations, monitor research topics, and find the code behind a paper through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Read the paper. Find the source.
interface.longDescription: Adds arXiv search, abstracts, bounded paper reading, original LaTeX section retrieval, citation graphs, BibTeX export, local semantic search, research alerts, and lookup of a paper's code repository and Hugging Face artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Find recent papers on a research topic and compare their methods.
Inspect the original LaTeX for an arXiv paper by section.
Find the official code and Hugging Face models for an arXiv paper.
